profile.positioning: A highly accomplished and results-oriented Engineering Leader with over 12 years of experience architecting, building, and scaling high-performance, secure payment infrastructure. My expertise lies in designing resilient systems capable of handling massive transaction volumes while adhering to complex regulatory landscapes. I’m passionate about bridging the gap between innovation and reliability in the fintech space and possess a proven track record of leading and mentoring high-performing engineering teams. Currently, I lead a team responsible for core payment processing at NovaPay, focusing on optimizing transaction throughput and reducing operational costs. However, my career has been fundamentally shaped by my time at Zawadi Pay, where I spearheaded the development of a real-time fraud detection system that significantly reduced losses and enabled rapid expansion into new African markets. This experience instilled in me a deep understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities presented by emerging economies. I'm now seeking a leadership role in a forward-thinking organization where I can leverage my expertise to build and scale the next generation of global payment solutions. I believe my ability to translate complex business requirements into robust technical architectures, coupled with my commitment to fostering a collaborative and data-driven engineering culture, makes me a valuable asset to any team focused on innovation and growth. I’m particularly interested in roles that involve architecting solutions for cross-border payments, decentralized finance, or open banking initiatives.
